sa.choice.trust: Trust it to face this on its own.
sa.bulbasaur.1.b1: At an overgrown greenhouse, Bulbasaur slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.bulbasaur.1.b2: It waters a wilted sprout with its vines again and again, as if keeping one small thing alive is its job.
sa.bulbasaur.2.b1: A wild Pokémon tramples the sprout. Bulbasaur plants itself in front of what is left and will not move.
sa.bulbasaur.2.b2: Bulbasaur looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.bulbasaur.3.b1: Bulbasaur no longer guards one sprout. It guards the whole team, and it seems to have decided that was the point all along.
sa.bulbasaur.3.b2: Something settles between you and Bulbasaur. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.charmander.1.b1: At a rain-soaked bridge, Charmander slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.charmander.1.b2: It curls around its tail flame every time the rain picks up, shaking more than the cold explains.
sa.charmander.2.b1: The rain turns to a downpour. Charmander looks at the storm, then at you, and steps out from under cover.
sa.charmander.2.b2: Charmander looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.charmander.3.b1: Charmander's flame burns brighter in the rain now. It decided that a fire worth carrying is one you do not hide.
sa.charmander.3.b2: Something settles between you and Charmander. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.squirtle.1.b1: At a quiet harbour, Squirtle slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.squirtle.1.b2: It plays tricks on everyone, but the jokes stop the moment a bigger Pokémon looks its way.
sa.squirtle.2.b1: A Wingull steals its shell polish. Squirtle chases it to the end of the pier and has to choose: laugh it off, or stand its ground.
sa.squirtle.2.b2: Squirtle looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.squirtle.3.b1: Squirtle still jokes, but now it jokes after it has stood its ground. The laugh comes easier that way.
sa.squirtle.3.b2: Something settles between you and Squirtle. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.chikorita.1.b1: At a sunlit meadow, Chikorita slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.chikorita.1.b2: It keeps brushing its leaf against you, checking that you are still there.
sa.chikorita.2.b1: A wild Pokémon in the meadow is hurt and alone. Chikorita leaves your side for the first time to help it.
sa.chikorita.2.b2: Chikorita looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.chikorita.3.b1: Chikorita learned that caring for you does not mean never leaving your side. It comes back every time, and that is enough.
sa.chikorita.3.b2: Something settles between you and Chikorita. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.cyndaquil.1.b1: At a cold mountain pass, Cyndaquil slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.cyndaquil.1.b2: Its back flames flicker out whenever it is startled, and it hates that you saw.
sa.cyndaquil.2.b1: An avalanche rumbles above the pass. Cyndaquil's flames sputter, then catch.
sa.cyndaquil.2.b2: Cyndaquil looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.cyndaquil.3.b1: Cyndaquil's flames stay lit now, even when it is afraid. It does not have to be fearless, only lit.
sa.cyndaquil.3.b2: Something settles between you and Cyndaquil. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.totodile.1.b1: At a fishing village, Totodile slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.totodile.1.b2: It steals bait from every bucket in the village and grins while it does.
sa.totodile.2.b1: An old fisher stops shouting and just looks tired. Totodile drops the bait and does not know what to do with its jaws.
sa.totodile.2.b2: Totodile looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.totodile.3.b1: Totodile still bites at everything, but now it chooses what. It brought the fisher a fish the next morning.
sa.totodile.3.b2: Something settles between you and Totodile. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.treecko.1.b1: At a tall forest canopy, Treecko slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.treecko.1.b2: It climbs ahead and waits on high branches, as if travelling with someone is something it is still deciding about.
sa.treecko.2.b1: A branch snaps under it. You are the one who catches it.
sa.treecko.2.b2: Treecko looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.treecko.3.b1: Treecko still climbs ahead. It just looks back now, every few branches, to make sure you are coming too.
sa.treecko.3.b2: Something settles between you and Treecko. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.torchic.1.b1: At a training ground, Torchic slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.torchic.1.b2: It challenges every Pokémon it sees and loses most of the time, then glares at you as if you should have warned it.
sa.torchic.2.b1: A trainer laughs at its tiny flame. Torchic does not attack. It trains, alone, until dark.
sa.torchic.2.b2: Torchic looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.torchic.3.b1: Torchic stopped picking fights to prove itself. It fights to get stronger now, and it is winning more.
sa.torchic.3.b2: Something settles between you and Torchic. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.mudkip.1.b1: At a muddy riverbank, Mudkip slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.mudkip.1.b2: It refuses to leave the river even when the team moves on, digging its feet into the mud.
sa.mudkip.2.b1: The river floods. Mudkip finally sees why it was so stubborn: it was listening to the water.
sa.mudkip.2.b2: Mudkip looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.mudkip.3.b1: Mudkip's stubbornness turned into something steadier. It trusts its own senses now, and you trust them too.
sa.mudkip.3.b2: Something settles between you and Mudkip. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.turtwig.1.b1: At a grove of old trees, Turtwig slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.turtwig.1.b2: It watches the old trees for hours, serious and silent, as if waiting to be told something.
sa.turtwig.2.b1: A wildfire threatens the grove. Turtwig does not wait for anyone to tell it what to do.
sa.turtwig.2.b2: Turtwig looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.turtwig.3.b1: Turtwig still listens to the old trees. But it learned that sometimes the one who has to speak is itself.
sa.turtwig.3.b2: Something settles between you and Turtwig. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.chimchar.1.b1: At a busy city square, Chimchar slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.chimchar.1.b2: It bounces off every wall, too fast to sit still, and other trainers keep asking you to calm it down.
sa.chimchar.2.b1: A child gets lost in the crowd. Chimchar's restless energy is the only thing quick enough to find her.
sa.chimchar.2.b2: Chimchar looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.chimchar.3.b1: Chimchar is still never still. But now it knows its energy can be pointed at something that matters.
sa.chimchar.3.b2: Something settles between you and Chimchar. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.piplup.1.b1: At an icy shoreline, Piplup slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.piplup.1.b2: It refuses help from anyone, even when it slips on the ice in front of everybody.
sa.piplup.2.b1: It falls through thin ice. You reach for it, and for once Piplup takes the help.
sa.piplup.2.b2: Piplup looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.piplup.3.b1: Piplup is still proud. It just learned that pride and accepting a hand can live in the same Pokémon.
sa.piplup.3.b2: Something settles between you and Piplup. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.snivy.1.b1: At an old library, Snivy slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.snivy.1.b2: It studies every battle afterward, cold and quiet, and seems to judge your choices.
sa.snivy.2.b1: It makes a plan that fails badly. For the first time Snivy looks to you instead of to its own thinking.
sa.snivy.2.b2: Snivy looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.snivy.3.b1: Snivy still plans everything. But its plans include you now, and they are better for it.
sa.snivy.3.b2: Something settles between you and Snivy. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.tepig.1.b1: At a roadside diner, Tepig slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.tepig.1.b2: It snorts warm puffs of smoke at every stranger, hoping each one will be a friend.
sa.tepig.2.b1: A Pokémon it befriended leaves without looking back. Tepig sits outside the diner for a long time.
sa.tepig.2.b2: Tepig looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.tepig.3.b1: Tepig still loves easily. It learned that a friend who leaves does not take the warmth with them.
sa.tepig.3.b2: Something settles between you and Tepig. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.oshawott.1.b1: At a waterfall shrine, Oshawott slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.oshawott.1.b2: It practises with its scalchop for hours, but it drops it every time someone watches.
sa.oshawott.2.b1: A rival's Pokémon mocks its form. Oshawott raises its scalchop, hands steady for once.
sa.oshawott.2.b2: Oshawott looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.oshawott.3.b1: Oshawott does not drop its scalchop anymore. It found out it fights best when it stops worrying who is watching.
sa.oshawott.3.b2: Something settles between you and Oshawott. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.chespin.1.b1: At a sheltered valley, Chespin slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.chespin.1.b2: It raises its spines at every noise and puts itself between you and everything.
sa.chespin.2.b1: The noise turns out to be a frightened Pokémon. Chespin lowers its spines and offers it a nut instead.
sa.chespin.2.b2: Chespin looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.chespin.3.b1: Chespin still protects you. It just learned that sometimes protecting means letting someone in.
sa.chespin.3.b2: Something settles between you and Chespin. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.fennekin.1.b1: At a stargazing hill, Fennekin slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.fennekin.1.b2: It stares into the fire at camp as if reading something there, then won't tell you what.
sa.fennekin.2.b1: One night the fire shows it a path. Fennekin leads, and it is right.
sa.fennekin.2.b2: Fennekin looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.fennekin.3.b1: Fennekin trusts what it sees in the flames now, and it shares what it sees with you.
sa.fennekin.3.b2: Something settles between you and Fennekin. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.froakie.1.b1: At a misty marsh, Froakie slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.froakie.1.b2: It hides in the mist and pelts the team with bubbles, then vanishes before anyone can scold it.
sa.froakie.2.b1: The mist thickens and the team gets separated. Froakie is the only one who can find everyone.
sa.froakie.2.b2: Froakie looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.froakie.3.b1: Froakie still disappears into the mist. It just always comes back with someone it found.
sa.froakie.3.b2: Something settles between you and Froakie. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.rowlet.1.b1: At a moonlit ruin, Rowlet slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.rowlet.1.b2: It sleeps through almost everything, then wakes with its feathers on end at the smallest sound.
sa.rowlet.2.b1: Something moves in the ruin. Rowlet is awake before anyone else and does not hesitate.
sa.rowlet.2.b2: Rowlet looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.rowlet.3.b1: Rowlet still naps. But when it matters, it is the first one awake.
sa.rowlet.3.b2: Something settles between you and Rowlet. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.litten.1.b1: At a back alley, Litten slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.litten.1.b2: It eats alone, away from the team, and hisses when anyone comes too close.
sa.litten.2.b1: You leave a share of your food by its side and walk away. Later, it is sitting next to you.
sa.litten.2.b2: Litten looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.litten.3.b1: Litten still keeps its distance from most of the world. Not from you.
sa.litten.3.b2: Something settles between you and Litten. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.popplio.1.b1: At a seaside stage, Popplio slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.popplio.1.b2: It practises balloons all day, but they pop the moment anyone claps.
sa.popplio.2.b1: A crowd gathers. Popplio's balloon wobbles and holds.
sa.popplio.2.b2: Popplio looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.popplio.3.b1: Popplio's balloons hold now. It learned that the clapping was never the scary part.
sa.popplio.3.b2: Something settles between you and Popplio. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.grookey.1.b1: At a forest clearing, Grookey slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.grookey.1.b2: It drums on everything, all the time, and the noise drives the team a little mad.
sa.grookey.2.b1: The team is lost in the dark. Grookey's drumming is the beat everyone follows home.
sa.grookey.2.b2: Grookey looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.grookey.3.b1: Grookey still drums. The team listens now, because that beat brought them home once.
sa.grookey.3.b2: Something settles between you and Grookey. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.scorbunny.1.b1: At a dusty pitch, Scorbunny slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.scorbunny.1.b2: It sprints into every fight without thinking and burns its feet on the ground.
sa.scorbunny.2.b1: It charges a foe that is far too strong. You call it back, and it actually listens.
sa.scorbunny.2.b2: Scorbunny looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.scorbunny.3.b1: Scorbunny is still fast. It learned that the best sprint starts with one look back at you.
sa.scorbunny.3.b2: Something settles between you and Scorbunny. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.sobble.1.b1: At a crowded market, Sobble slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.sobble.1.b2: It turns invisible whenever a stranger speaks, and sometimes cries when it can't.
sa.sobble.2.b1: A child in the market is crying too. Sobble stays visible and sits beside her.
sa.sobble.2.b2: Sobble looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.sobble.3.b1: Sobble still hides sometimes. It learned that being seen can be a kind thing to do for someone else.
sa.sobble.3.b2: Something settles between you and Sobble. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.sprigatito.1.b1: At a flower garden, Sprigatito slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.sprigatito.1.b2: It knocks things off tables just to watch you pick them up.
sa.sprigatito.2.b1: It knocks over something that matters to you. Sprigatito sees your face and freezes.
sa.sprigatito.2.b2: Sprigatito looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.sprigatito.3.b1: Sprigatito still makes mischief. It brought you a flower the next day, and it did not knock that one over.
sa.sprigatito.3.b2: Something settles between you and Sprigatito. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.fuecoco.1.b1: At a picnic ground, Fuecoco slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.fuecoco.1.b2: It naps through training and wakes only for snacks.
sa.fuecoco.2.b1: A hungry wild Pokémon eyes the team's food. Fuecoco gets up, slowly, and shares.
sa.fuecoco.2.b2: Fuecoco looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.fuecoco.3.b1: Fuecoco is still unhurried. It learned that some things are worth getting up for.
sa.fuecoco.3.b2: Something settles between you and Fuecoco. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.quaxly.1.b1: At a city fountain, Quaxly slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.quaxly.1.b2: It straightens its feathers before every battle and fusses if anything is out of place.
sa.quaxly.2.b1: A battle leaves it soaked and scruffy. It won anyway, and nobody cared about the feathers.
sa.quaxly.2.b2: Quaxly looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.quaxly.3.b1: Quaxly still keeps its feathers neat. It learned that it is not the tidiness that wins.
sa.quaxly.3.b2: Something settles between you and Quaxly. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.dratini.1.b1: At a still lake, Dratini slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.dratini.1.b2: It circles the lake shore as if looking for someone who used to be there.
sa.dratini.2.b1: A shimmer under the water. It is only a reflection, but Dratini watches it for a long time.
sa.dratini.2.b2: Dratini looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.dratini.3.b1: Dratini stopped circling the lake. It found who it was looking for: the team it travels with now.
sa.dratini.3.b2: Something settles between you and Dratini. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.larvitar.1.b1: At a gravel quarry, Larvitar slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.larvitar.1.b2: It eats through rocks the team needs to cross and refuses to stop.
sa.larvitar.2.b1: The quarry collapses. Larvitar holds up the stone above you while everyone gets clear.
sa.larvitar.2.b2: Larvitar looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.larvitar.3.b1: Larvitar is still as stubborn as stone. It decided that the thing worth being stubborn about is the team.
sa.larvitar.3.b2: Something settles between you and Larvitar. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.bagon.1.b1: At a cliff edge, Bagon slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.bagon.1.b2: It jumps from every ledge it finds, trying to fly, and lands hard every time.
sa.bagon.2.b1: It stands at the tallest cliff yet. This time it waits for you before it jumps.
sa.bagon.2.b2: Bagon looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.bagon.3.b1: Bagon still dreams of flying. It learned that it does not have to jump alone.
sa.bagon.3.b2: Something settles between you and Bagon. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.beldum.1.b1: At an abandoned lab, Beldum slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.beldum.1.b2: It hovers in place for long minutes, computing something it will not share.
sa.beldum.2.b1: The lab's old machines switch on. Beldum turns them off, one by one, then looks to you.
sa.beldum.2.b2: Beldum looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.beldum.3.b1: Beldum still calculates everything. You are the one variable it decided not to compute.
sa.beldum.3.b2: Something settles between you and Beldum. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.gible.1.b1: At a sandy cave, Gible slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.gible.1.b2: It bites everything it finds, including the team's bags and once your hat.
sa.gible.2.b1: A rockfall traps a wild Pokémon. Gible bites through the stone to free it.
sa.gible.2.b2: Gible looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.gible.3.b1: Gible still bites far too much. But it learned what its jaws are good for.
sa.gible.3.b2: Something settles between you and Gible. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.deino.1.b1: At a dark canyon, Deino slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.deino.1.b2: It can't see well and charges at anything that moves, friend or foe.
sa.deino.2.b1: It charges at you in the dark, then stops: it knows your voice.
sa.deino.2.b2: Deino looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.deino.3.b1: Deino still charges. But it stops when you speak, every time.
sa.deino.3.b2: Something settles between you and Deino. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.goomy.1.b1: At a rainy road, Goomy slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.goomy.1.b2: It hides from every raindrop, even though it is made of slime.
sa.goomy.2.b1: The rain stops. Goomy looks almost disappointed.
sa.goomy.2.b2: Goomy looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.goomy.3.b1: Goomy learned to love the rain. And it learned that hiding was never really what it wanted.
sa.goomy.3.b2: Something settles between you and Goomy. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.jangmo_o.1.b1: At a mountain dojo, Jangmo-o slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.jangmo_o.1.b2: It clangs its scales at every Pokémon it meets, demanding a battle.
sa.jangmo_o.2.b1: An old dojo master's Pokémon refuses to fight it. Jangmo-o is confused into silence.
sa.jangmo_o.2.b2: Jangmo-o looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.jangmo_o.3.b1: Jangmo-o still loves to battle. It learned that the best battles are the ones both sides want.
sa.jangmo_o.3.b2: Something settles between you and Jangmo-o. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.dreepy.1.b1: At a foggy graveyard, Dreepy slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.dreepy.1.b2: It drifts away from the team at night, toward somewhere it will not explain.
sa.dreepy.2.b1: You follow it and find where it was going: a place it used to call home.
sa.dreepy.2.b2: Dreepy looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.dreepy.3.b1: Dreepy still drifts sometimes. But it always drifts back to you now.
sa.dreepy.3.b2: Something settles between you and Dreepy. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.frigibax.1.b1: At a frozen pass, Frigibax slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.frigibax.1.b2: It refuses to be warmed by the fire, sitting stubbornly in the snow.
sa.frigibax.2.b1: A blizzard hits. Frigibax finally comes close, and the fire lets it.
sa.frigibax.2.b2: Frigibax looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.frigibax.3.b1: Frigibax still loves the cold. It just learned that warmth from a friend does not melt anything important.
sa.frigibax.3.b2: Something settles between you and Frigibax. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.pichu.1.b1: At a power station, Pichu slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.pichu.1.b2: It sparks at everything, then flinches from its own static.
sa.pichu.2.b1: The station's lights go out. Pichu's tiny spark is the only light left.
sa.pichu.2.b2: Pichu looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.pichu.3.b1: Pichu still shocks itself sometimes. But it learned how much light one small spark can make.
sa.pichu.3.b2: Something settles between you and Pichu. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.tuftin.1.b1: At a cosy farmhouse, Tuftin slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.tuftin.1.b2: It follows you everywhere, even into places it is clearly scared of.
sa.tuftin.2.b1: It gets lost in the barn, alone. When you find it, it is not crying.
sa.tuftin.2.b2: Tuftin looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.tuftin.3.b1: Tuftin still follows you everywhere. But it learned it could be brave without you, too.
sa.tuftin.3.b2: Something settles between you and Tuftin. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.magby.1.b1: At a volcanic vent, Magby slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.magby.1.b2: It breathes fire at everything that annoys it, which is most things.
sa.magby.2.b1: Its fire sets a field alight. Magby is the first to stamp it out.
sa.magby.2.b2: Magby looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.magby.3.b1: Magby still has a temper. It learned that fire you can control is worth more than fire you can't.
sa.magby.3.b2: Something settles between you and Magby. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.elekid.1.b1: At a storm-wracked tower, Elekid slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.elekid.1.b2: It challenges the thunder itself, arms whirling.
sa.elekid.2.b1: Lightning strikes near you. Elekid takes the charge so you do not have to.
sa.elekid.2.b2: Elekid looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.elekid.3.b1: Elekid still wants to beat the storm. It learned that some fights are worth fighting for someone else.
sa.elekid.3.b2: Something settles between you and Elekid. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.togepi.1.b1: At a nursery garden, Togepi slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.togepi.1.b2: It giggles at everything, even when things are going badly.
sa.togepi.2.b1: Things go very badly. Togepi giggles anyway, and somehow the team laughs with it.
sa.togepi.2.b2: Togepi looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.togepi.3.b1: Togepi's luck may be real or not. Its cheer certainly is.
sa.togepi.3.b2: Something settles between you and Togepi. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.aron.1.b1: At an iron mine, Aron slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.aron.1.b2: It eats the rails, the tools and very nearly the cart.
sa.aron.2.b1: The mine's supports start to give. Aron stands under them, solid as steel.
sa.aron.2.b2: Aron looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.aron.3.b1: Aron still eats iron. It learned that being solid is a gift you can give to others.
sa.aron.3.b2: Something settles between you and Aron. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.pidgey.1.b1: At a windy plain, Pidgey slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.pidgey.1.b2: It flies in circles, never landing, like it is afraid to stop.
sa.pidgey.2.b1: A gust knocks it down. It lands on your shoulder and stays there.
sa.pidgey.2.b2: Pidgey looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.pidgey.3.b1: Pidgey still loves to fly. It learned that landing is part of flying too.
sa.pidgey.3.b2: Something settles between you and Pidgey. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.hoothoot.1.b1: At a night forest, Hoothoot slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.hoothoot.1.b2: It stands on one foot all night, counting something.
sa.hoothoot.2.b1: It counts the stars and finds one missing. It leads you to a lost Pokémon under it.
sa.hoothoot.2.b2: Hoothoot looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.hoothoot.3.b1: Hoothoot still counts everything. It learned that some things are worth counting.
sa.hoothoot.3.b2: Something settles between you and Hoothoot. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.taillow.1.b1: At a stormy sky, Taillow slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.taillow.1.b2: It dives at bigger Pokémon without fear and gets knocked out of the sky.
sa.taillow.2.b1: A huge flying Pokémon threatens the team. Taillow dives, and this time it does not miss.
sa.taillow.2.b2: Taillow looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.taillow.3.b1: Taillow is still braver than it is big. It learned that bravery and skill can grow together.
sa.taillow.3.b2: Something settles between you and Taillow. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.starly.1.b1: At a flock's roost, Starly slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.starly.1.b2: It keeps flying back to a flock that does not seem to want it.
sa.starly.2.b1: The flock is attacked. Starly fights for them anyway.
sa.starly.2.b2: Starly looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.starly.3.b1: Starly does not need the flock's welcome anymore. It found a team that flies with it.
sa.starly.3.b2: Something settles between you and Starly. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.pidove.1.b1: At a busy station, Pidove slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.pidove.1.b2: It hides under benches whenever a crowd passes.
sa.pidove.2.b1: It gets separated in the crowd. It finds you by itself.
sa.pidove.2.b2: Pidove looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.pidove.3.b1: Pidove still dislikes crowds. It learned that it can find its way through them.
sa.pidove.3.b2: Something settles between you and Pidove. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.fletchling.1.b1: At a race course, Fletchling slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.fletchling.1.b2: It races every Pokémon it meets and sulks when it loses.
sa.fletchling.2.b1: It loses a race to a slower Pokémon that never gave up. Fletchling thinks about that.
sa.fletchling.2.b2: Fletchling looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.fletchling.3.b1: Fletchling still loves to race. It learned that the race is against yourself.
sa.fletchling.3.b2: Something settles between you and Fletchling. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.pikipek.1.b1: At an old orchard, Pikipek slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.pikipek.1.b2: It pecks holes in everything, including the camp's cooking pot.
sa.pikipek.2.b1: It pecks a rhythm on a tree, and the team starts humming along.
sa.pikipek.2.b2: Pikipek looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.pikipek.3.b1: Pikipek still pecks too much. But now it pecks songs.
sa.pikipek.3.b2: Something settles between you and Pikipek. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.rookidee.1.b1: At a crossroads, Rookidee slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.rookidee.1.b2: It takes every challenge seriously, even the silly ones.
sa.rookidee.2.b1: A small Pokémon challenges it to a game of tag. Rookidee plays, very seriously, and loses.
sa.rookidee.2.b2: Rookidee looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.rookidee.3.b1: Rookidee is still serious. It learned that losing a silly game can be the best part of the day.
sa.rookidee.3.b2: Something settles between you and Rookidee. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.wattrel.1.b1: At a stormy coast, Wattrel slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.wattrel.1.b2: It flies into storms for fun and comes back crackling and pleased.
sa.wattrel.2.b1: A storm gets too strong. Wattrel comes back to the team first, before anything else.
sa.wattrel.2.b2: Wattrel looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.wattrel.3.b1: Wattrel still loves storms. It learned that coming home is part of the fun.
sa.wattrel.3.b2: Something settles between you and Wattrel. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.rhyhorn.1.b1: At a rocky gorge, Rhyhorn slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.rhyhorn.1.b2: It charges in a straight line and never turns, no matter what is in the way.
sa.rhyhorn.2.b1: You are in the way. Rhyhorn turns.
sa.rhyhorn.2.b2: Rhyhorn looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.rhyhorn.3.b1: Rhyhorn still charges straight. It learned that the one thing worth turning for is you.
sa.rhyhorn.3.b2: Something settles between you and Rhyhorn. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.porygon.1.b1: At a data centre, Porygon slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.porygon.1.b2: It flickers when it is nervous and asks the same questions over and over.
sa.porygon.2.b1: A system crash scrambles its memory. It remembers you first.
sa.porygon.2.b2: Porygon looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.porygon.3.b1: Porygon still worries. It learned that the most important data is the kind you never lose.
sa.porygon.3.b2: Something settles between you and Porygon. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.mankey.1.b1: At a mountain trail, Mankey slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.mankey.1.b2: It loses its temper at rocks, trees and its own reflection.
sa.mankey.2.b1: It loses its temper at you, then stops, ashamed.
sa.mankey.2.b2: Mankey looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.mankey.3.b1: Mankey still gets angry. It learned that you will stay anyway, and that makes it calmer.
sa.mankey.3.b2: Something settles between you and Mankey. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.gastly.1.b1: At an old mansion, Gastly slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.gastly.1.b2: It sneaks up and spooks everyone, then cackles.
sa.gastly.2.b1: A real ghost spooks Gastly. It hides behind you for the first time.
sa.gastly.2.b2: Gastly looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.gastly.3.b1: Gastly still loves a good fright. It learned that it likes being safe too.
sa.gastly.3.b2: Something settles between you and Gastly. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.abra.1.b1: At a sleepy village, Abra slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.abra.1.b2: It sleeps eighteen hours a day and teleports away from anything boring.
sa.abra.2.b1: Something important happens while it is asleep. Abra wakes and teleports to help.
sa.abra.2.b2: Abra looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.abra.3.b1: Abra still sleeps a lot. It learned how to tell when something matters enough to wake up.
sa.abra.3.b2: Something settles between you and Abra. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.machop.1.b1: At a training gym, Machop slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.machop.1.b2: It lifts heavy things all day to show off its muscles.
sa.machop.2.b1: It cannot lift something on its own. It asks for help.
sa.machop.2.b2: Machop looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.machop.3.b1: Machop is still strong. It learned that asking for help is a kind of strength too.
sa.machop.3.b2: Something settles between you and Machop. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.magnemite.1.b1: At a broken power line, Magnemite slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.magnemite.1.b2: It hums at fixed intervals and does exactly what it is told.
sa.magnemite.2.b1: Someone gives it a bad order. Magnemite stops humming and does what is right.
sa.magnemite.2.b2: Magnemite looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.magnemite.3.b1: Magnemite still follows the rules. It learned that the best rule is to think for itself.
sa.magnemite.3.b2: Something settles between you and Magnemite. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.shinx.1.b1: At a dark tunnel, Shinx slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.shinx.1.b2: It flashes its fur at every shadow, ready to fight.
sa.shinx.2.b1: The tunnel goes black. Shinx's glow is the only way through.
sa.shinx.2.b2: Shinx looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.shinx.3.b1: Shinx is still ready to fight. It learned that its light is for showing the way too.
sa.shinx.3.b2: Something settles between you and Shinx. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.weedle.1.b1: At a forest path, Weedle slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.weedle.1.b2: It stays close and bristles at anything that approaches you.
sa.weedle.2.b1: An old friend from the forest calls to it. Weedle looks back at you and stays.
sa.weedle.2.b2: Weedle looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.weedle.3.b1: Weedle chose you. It still bristles at strangers, but it never doubts where it belongs.
sa.weedle.3.b2: Something settles between you and Weedle. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.caterpie.1.b1: At a cocoon tree, Caterpie slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.caterpie.1.b2: It watches butterflies overhead as if it already knows it will be one of them.
sa.caterpie.2.b1: It sees a fallen Butterfree. Caterpie stays with it until the end.
sa.caterpie.2.b2: Caterpie looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.caterpie.3.b1: Caterpie still dreams of flying. It learned that there is grace in every stage, even this one.
sa.caterpie.3.b2: Something settles between you and Caterpie. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.nidoran_f.1.b1: At a burrow field, Nidoran♀ slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.nidoran_f.1.b2: It guards the burrows of strangers as if they were its own family.
sa.nidoran_f.2.b1: A burrow collapses. Nidoran♀ digs until everyone is out.
sa.nidoran_f.2.b2: Nidoran♀ looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.nidoran_f.3.b1: Nidoran♀ still guards everyone. It learned that the team is the burrow it guards most.
sa.nidoran_f.3.b2: Something settles between you and Nidoran♀. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.nidoran_m.1.b1: At a rocky slope, Nidoran♂ slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.nidoran_m.1.b2: It charges at anything with a horn bigger than its own.
sa.nidoran_m.2.b1: It meets a Pokémon with a much bigger horn that only wants to play. Nidoran♂ is confused.
sa.nidoran_m.2.b2: Nidoran♂ looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.nidoran_m.3.b1: Nidoran♂ still charges. It learned that not every horn is a challenge.
sa.nidoran_m.3.b2: Something settles between you and Nidoran♂. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.poliwag.1.b1: At a lily pond, Poliwag slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.poliwag.1.b2: It spins in circles when it is happy and dizzies itself.
sa.poliwag.2.b1: It spins to cheer up a sad Pokémon, and the Pokémon laughs.
sa.poliwag.2.b2: Poliwag looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.poliwag.3.b1: Poliwag still spins. It learned that its swirl can make others happy too.
sa.poliwag.3.b2: Something settles between you and Poliwag. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.oddish.1.b1: At a midnight field, Oddish slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.oddish.1.b2: It wanders off at night to plant itself under the moon.
sa.oddish.2.b1: One night it does not come back. You find it watching over a sprouting seed.
sa.oddish.2.b2: Oddish looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.oddish.3.b1: Oddish still wanders at night. It learned that it always has someone to come back to.
sa.oddish.3.b2: Something settles between you and Oddish. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.swinub.1.b1: At a snowy trail, Swinub slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.swinub.1.b2: It digs for food in the snow and will not stop even when the team moves on.
sa.swinub.2.b1: It digs up something wonderful and shares it.
sa.swinub.2.b2: Swinub looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.swinub.3.b1: Swinub is still stubborn about digging. It learned that what it finds is better shared.
sa.swinub.3.b2: Something settles between you and Swinub. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.ralts.1.b1: At a quiet station, Ralts slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.ralts.1.b2: It hides behind you whenever strong feelings fill a room.
sa.ralts.2.b1: Your feelings fill the room. Ralts does not hide this time.
sa.ralts.2.b2: Ralts looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.ralts.3.b1: Ralts still feels everything. It learned that feelings are a way to understand, not only to fear.
sa.ralts.3.b2: Something settles between you and Ralts. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.trapinch.1.b1: At a desert pit, Trapinch slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.trapinch.1.b2: It waits at the bottom of a pit for hours, very serious about it.
sa.trapinch.2.b1: Nothing comes. Trapinch climbs out and follows you instead.
sa.trapinch.2.b2: Trapinch looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.trapinch.3.b1: Trapinch still loves a good pit. It learned that waiting is not the only way to catch what you want.
sa.trapinch.3.b2: Something settles between you and Trapinch. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.duskull.1.b1: At a lantern-lit graveyard, Duskull slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.duskull.1.b2: It drifts between gravestones as if checking on old friends.
sa.duskull.2.b1: It leads you to one grave in particular, then stays very still.
sa.duskull.2.b2: Duskull looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.duskull.3.b1: Duskull still watches over the departed. It learned that it can watch over the living too.
sa.duskull.3.b2: Something settles between you and Duskull. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.sandile.1.b1: At a sun-baked dune, Sandile slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.sandile.1.b2: It keeps its eyes half closed and trusts nobody.
sa.sandile.2.b1: You fall asleep in the sun. When you wake, Sandile is still keeping watch.
sa.sandile.2.b2: Sandile looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.sandile.3.b1: Sandile still trusts almost nobody. It decided you are not almost nobody.
sa.sandile.3.b2: Something settles between you and Sandile. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.pawniard.1.b1: At an old barracks, Pawniard slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.pawniard.1.b2: It follows orders exactly and looks lost without them.
sa.pawniard.2.b1: You give it no order. It has to choose for itself.
sa.pawniard.2.b2: Pawniard looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.pawniard.3.b1: Pawniard still respects orders. It learned that the best orders are the ones it would choose anyway.
sa.pawniard.3.b2: Something settles between you and Pawniard. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.grubbin.1.b1: At a charging station, Grubbin slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.grubbin.1.b2: It digs into everything to see what is inside.
sa.grubbin.2.b1: It digs into a broken machine and finds a way to fix it.
sa.grubbin.2.b2: Grubbin looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.grubbin.3.b1: Grubbin is still curious about everything. It learned that curiosity can build as well as dig.
sa.grubbin.3.b2: Something settles between you and Grubbin. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.blipbug.1.b1: At a radio tower, Blipbug slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.blipbug.1.b2: It hides from loud signals and covers its antennae.
sa.blipbug.2.b1: It hears a quiet distress call under the noise. Only Blipbug could have heard it.
sa.blipbug.2.b2: Blipbug looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.blipbug.3.b1: Blipbug still dislikes noise. It learned that its sharp hearing is a gift.
sa.blipbug.3.b2: Something settles between you and Blipbug. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.vulpix.1.b1: At a lantern-lit festival, Vulpix slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.vulpix.1.b2: It hides behind you whenever the festival crowds come close, its six tails tucked tight.
sa.vulpix.2.b1: A lantern topples and a stall catches fire. Vulpix steps out from behind you and draws the flames into its tails.
sa.vulpix.2.b2: Vulpix looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.vulpix.3.b1: Vulpix still dislikes crowds. It learned that its fire can calm things down as well as light them up.
sa.vulpix.3.b2: Something settles between you and Vulpix. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.psyduck.1.b1: At a muddy pond, Psyduck slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.psyduck.1.b2: It holds its head and waddles in circles whenever the team argues.
sa.psyduck.2.b1: A wild Pokémon charges the team. Psyduck's headache flares, and so does a wave of psychic power.
sa.psyduck.2.b2: Psyduck looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.psyduck.3.b1: Psyduck still gets headaches. It learned that the pressure inside it can be turned into something that protects the team.
sa.psyduck.3.b2: Something settles between you and Psyduck. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.eevee.1.b1: At a dusty attic, Eevee slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.eevee.1.b2: It sniffs every stone and every feather, as if it could become any of them and cannot choose.
sa.eevee.2.b1: A strange glow hums in a box of old things. Eevee presses against it, and its fur stands up.
sa.eevee.2.b2: Eevee looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.eevee.3.b1: Eevee stopped waiting to be told what to become. It carries a little glow now, and it chose where to point it.
sa.eevee.3.b2: Something settles between you and Eevee. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.toxel.1.b1: At a back-street music hall, Toxel slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.toxel.1.b2: It tunes itself to every noise it hears, and the noise leaves it jittery and sparking.
sa.toxel.2.b1: A guitar lies abandoned on the stage. Toxel plays one wrong note, then another, then a whole riff.
sa.toxel.2.b2: Toxel looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.toxel.3.b1: Toxel is still loud. It learned that a sound it makes on purpose is the best kind of noise.
sa.toxel.3.b2: Something settles between you and Toxel. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
sa.shieldon.1.b1: At a drowned quarry, Shieldon slows down. Something here has its full attention.
sa.shieldon.1.b2: It sits under the dripping rock for hours, heavy and slow, and will not be hurried.
sa.shieldon.2.b1: The old sludge pools rise. Shieldon plants itself in front of the team and takes the splash on its shield.
sa.shieldon.2.b2: Shieldon looks back at you, waiting to see what you will do.
sa.shieldon.3.b1: Shieldon is still slow. It learned that being the last thing between a friend and the water is worth the wait.
sa.shieldon.3.b2: Something settles between you and Shieldon. Whatever comes next, it has its own way of meeting it.
